text:
Priya Patel: Heads-up, I'm flying to PDX next Thu for meetings — anyone got vegetarian + gluten-free dinner recs in/near Pearl District? Also open to breakfast spots for Sat AM.
Ben G: Woodblock Tacos (not the chain) has great GF options and decent veggie bowls. 10 min from Pearl.
Samira: Highly recommend Harlow. small plates, good GF marking on menu. vibes are chill.
Maya: If you want something fancy, try Andina for Peruvian — they do lots of veggie/ceviche swaps. make reso.
Priya Patel: Love these, thanks! Any breakfast that's walkable from The Hoxton? (I'll be staying there)
Lin: Blue Star Donuts is amazing but not GF. For GF breakfast near Hoxton: Stumptown nearby for coffee + GF muffins, or Grains for a proper GF brunch.
Ben G: also, if you're okay with a 12-min ride, Nong's has the best Thai-inspired bowls — they label allergens well.
Priya Patel: perfect. Thinking Harlow for dinner Fri night — any experience with walk-ins vs reso?
Samira: Fri is busy. i'd book a table. Harlow's online booking is easy: https://harlow-pdx.example/book
Maya: If you want me to try book for the team dinner, I can. what's a safe # of ppl? 4? 6?
Priya Patel: just 2 for now (me + roommate). can you book for 2 Fri 7pm?
Maya: done — reservation confirmed. they sent a note: "table by the window". :sparkles:
FoodBot: quick tip — if anyone else is traveling to PDX, run `redwood-travel help pdx` for a consolidated rec list (coffee, lunch, late-night).
Lin: Also: if you want late-night dessert, Ruby Jewel has GF sorbet options.
Ben G: enjoy! bring back donut pics. :camera_with_flash: 
Priya Patel: will do, ty all :heart:
